summary.intent: Bootstrap release-please with correct version tags, align api-client versions with the API, and test the full release system with a quick task (expose API version on /health endpoint).
summary.outcome: Bootstrap tags created, api-client versions aligned, /health endpoint now returns version, and the release preview workflow was refactored to write release-as targets on the PR branch instead of post-merge to main. Several CI pipeline issues were discovered and fixed along the way.

repo: release-please treats the entire commit history as unreleased when no prior tags exist — bootstrap tags must be created at the last known stable commit to get a clean changelog

The pr-release-preview.js script computes packageBumps from commits and derives release-as targets from those; manual label overrides must be fed back into packageBumps or release-as derivation will use the wrong bump level
openapi.json is a generated file at packages/api-client/openapi.json — its info.version is set dynamically from npm_package_version at generation time, not via release-please
release-please extra-files jsonpath does not do surgical JSON field updates — it reformats the entire file, causing massive diffs for generated JSON files; should not be used for generated files
The CI 'Verify API Spec & Client' check does a semantic comparison of committed vs freshly generated openapi.json; it must exclude info.version since that field changes with every release bump

HealthController is excluded from the OpenApiGeneratorModule because it depends on TypeOrmHealthIndicator which needs a real DB connection — the health endpoint schema is defined manually in generate-openapi.ts
Legacy GitHub branch protection rules do not support per-actor bypass; only the newer Ruleset system does
Merge commits have 2+ parents in the GitHub PR commits API — must filter them out before conventional commit parsing to avoid false release labels
fix: commit type triggers a patch bump in release-please; chore(ci): should be used for CI-only changes to avoid version cascades

code.finding: Shared module created to centralize API version reading from package.json, used by both main.ts and health.controller.ts
Health endpoint now returns a version field sourced from the shared API_VERSION constant
Version reading uses process.env.npm_package_version with fallback to reading package.json directly; throws if neither is available
Manual label override detection block — must update packageBumps for affected packages to ensure release-as derivation uses the higher bump type, not the computed one
Commit loop must skip merge commits (2+ parents) to avoid false release labels from version-bump merge commits
Workflow now writes release-as targets to release-please-config.json on the PR branch and commits back, replacing the post-merge approach that failed due to branch protection
API spec verification now strips info.version before semantic comparison so release-bumped versions don't cause false failures
extra-files for openapi.json removed entirely — release-please reformats the whole file instead of doing surgical jsonpath updates, making it unsuitable for generated files

workflow: Squash-merging a fix: commit onto a chore(ci): branch via interactive rebase before force-pushing avoids unwanted version bumps from release-please

The post-merge release-as injection pattern (pushing to main from CI) is blocked by branch protection without per-actor bypass; moving the injection to the PR branch pre-merge is the safer alternative
Bootstrap tags should be created on the commit just before the first release-please run, not on HEAD, to exclude setup commits from the initial changelog
When release-please regenerates a release PR after config changes, previously failing status checks must be manually re-run since they reference the old PR state
GitHub App tokens used in CI still cannot push to main if 'Do not allow bypassing' is enabled on legacy branch protection rules even with admin permissions

friction: release-please extra-files jsonpath silently fails to do surgical JSON updates — reformats entire file instead, causing +564/-150 diffs on a single version field change
Legacy branch protection rules lack per-actor bypass, blocking the post-merge release-as push from a GitHub App token; required a full workflow redesign
git index.lock left behind by a background process blocked git switch, requiring manual removal
Cargo.lock regeneration pulled in unrelated dependency updates when only updating the crate version; had to restore original and manually patch only the workspace crates
PR #430 release PR required multiple re-runs as fixes landed across 4 separate PRs (#431, #432, #433, #434) before all checks passed
CodeRabbit and Copilot review rounds required multiple passes — each fix round triggered new review comments
open_items: PR #430 (release PR for api v0.36.0) still needs all CI checks to pass and merge — the openapi.json extra-files removal and version-ignore CI check (PR #434) must land first
The 15 bootstrap tags created may need verification that they resolve the full changelog bloat on the release PR — only 2 changes should appear
The phase 41 discussion log recorded a decision to use monotonic (major.minor) versioning for web and desktop apps — deferred in favor of semver for now, but should be revisited
The generate-openapi.ts script version example is now a static '1.0.0' string rather than the real version — consider whether this matters for SDK consumers reading the spec
